Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Luxe Luggage Co. specializes in the retail sale of high-quality leather goods and luggage, offering a curated selection of brands and styles. Our operations include an in-store shopping experience complemented by a fully secure online platform that ensures customer data protection through advanced cybersecurity measures. We also provide limited in-house repair services for our products, adhering to all safety regulations and employing a comprehensive loss prevention program that includes staff training on theft deterrence and inventory management. Our inventory is stored in well-monitored and secure locations, featuring locked display cases and alarm systems to mitigate theft and vandalism risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On April 15, 2023, a theft incident occurred at our retail store location, resulting in a loss of inventory valued at $2,500. The stolen items included high-end leather bags and accessories. The incident was reported to local law enforcement, and a police report was filed (Report #123456). The company's security measures, including surveillance cameras and alarm systems, were triggered, but the perpetrators managed to escape before law enforcement arrived. The claim has been submitted to our insurer, and we are currently awaiting resolution.
